data_policy: Identifier-only metadata; benchmark structures, poses, affinity/activity labels, embeddings, and model weights are not redistributed.

sources.pdbbind_mmseqs_target_groups: PDBbind v2020 target-group mapping used by the 2026-10-09 protein-LM shuffle controls; see docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md for the exact identity/coverage definition.

notes: LP-PDBBind model-compatible training and validation identifiers are derived from the upstream LP_PDBBind.csv using the documented CL/split/non-covalent filters; they are not asserted to be standalone upstream split files.
The DEKOIS 2.0 target inventory contains 81 targets and the associated sequence-query mapping has 88 rows because some targets have multiple chain queries.

The PDBbind target-group TSV contains only representative/member PDB identifiers (no sequences or structures) and is included to preserve the exact donor-exclusion mapping used by cross-target shuffle controls.

The MMseqs2 executable version used to create the frozen PDBbind target-group TSV was not retained in the available run metadata; the committed mapping and SHA-256 are the authoritative reproduction input.
